cart_empty_body: Add products from the catalog, then send the order to your supplier.
price_rule: Prices come from your supplier's price list and are shown on the order once it is saved; they are fixed when the order is approved.
save_failed: The order could not be saved
errors.quantity_invalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and 1,000,000.
errors.meters_invalid: Enter meters above 0, at most two decimals.
errors.too_many: An order can have at most 200 products.
draft_kept: The draft was saved; sending again only retries the submission.
price_rule_center: An empty price uses the dealer's purchase price; a product without a price is added at 0 and flagged. The order starts approved, ready for the warehouse.
price_missing_body_one: {{count}} product had no price; it was added at 0 and flagged.
price_missing_body_other: {{count}} products had no price; they were added at 0 and flagged.
errors.price_invalid: Enter a price of 0 or more with up to 4 decimals.
